(1) Renames in the eyes request: with --since, from a review's base and for a subdirectory target — git mv src.py reviews/src.py shows src.py's deletion and nothing of reviews/src.py; an ordinary rename shows the old path's deletion and the new file; a record moved to a source path shows the new file without the record's deletion. (2) Batching: with dwitbuk.PATHSPEC_BATCH_BYTES lowered (set it on the module, restore it after), an eyes request over many changed source files diffs every one of them, in git's order, and every git diff call it makes keeps its pathspec arguments within the limit (record the calls by wrapping dwitbuk.git); the diff equals what one unbatched git diff of those paths gives. (3) verify_packet's excluded_diff for an excluded bare hunsu.json, after hunsu.json became a directory holding a tracked child.py, holds nothing of child.py (child.py stays in diff when touched); an excluded entry ending in / still shows its files. (5) Q-hostcall: for both eyes_worker adapters, the child's env equals the parent's minus exactly the six identity/metadata keys, with AGENT_HOST/AGENT_WORKER set (and CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY=1 for claude), including HOME, LANG, an XDG_*, an SSH_*, a CLAUDE_CODE_* and an arbitrary marker key. Red evidence is the real suite or focused python3 -c runs, never python3 -m unittest; no mutation campaign. Change no repository file but test_dwitbuk.py; do not commit.
